data.summary: The FR-001 Card transaction fraud detector shows strong discrimination as measured by Gini — test {{m:run_a8410e:gini.test}} and Gini — out-of-time (simulated) {{m:run_a8410e:gini.oot}}. Temporal stability is confirmed by KS — out-of-time {{m:run_a8410e:ks.oot}} and AUC — hold-out {{m:run_a8410e:auc.holdout}}. Calibration quality is reflected by Predicted × observed — hold-out {{m:run_a8410e:calibration_ratio.holdout}} and Brier score — hold-out {{m:run_a8410e:brier.holdout}}. The model attains high precision at coded threshold {{m:run_a8410e:precision_at.holdout}}, solid recall at coded threshold {{m:run_a8410e:recall_at.holdout}}, and strong average precision (PR‑AUC) {{m:run_a8410e:avg_precision.holdout}}. Validation uncovered two findings—a high-severity alert-threshold issue and a medium-severity data-control issue—resulting in an overall rating of Requires remediation before continued use. Parity versus the legacy model is summarized by parity vs legacy: coef_max_abs_diff {{m:run_a8410e:coef_max_abs_diff}}, score_max_abs_diff {{m:run_a8410e:score_max_abs_diff}}, and rows_compared {{m:run_a8410e:rows_compared}}.
